title: Grammar Warm-Up
subtitle: True or false? Decide whether each statement about explanation texts is correct.

title: Before we write: the checklist.
lines: As you draft today, keep these in mind:
•  Each section explains WHAT, HOW and WHY
•  At least three different connectives across the piece
•  Conclusion that links the skills together
Use the model text and your boxing-up grid.
Your draft should be complete by the end of today’s session.
